# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c8 P1](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0001), [v1 c8 P9](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** managing a farm and household  <sub>[v2 c22 P24](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Thirza has a stern face that rarely shows smiles. She moves with a brisk step and possesses a sharp, watchful gaze.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c3 P13](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0013), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000)_

## Personality

Thirza is a practical, firm, and orderly woman who values deference, dutifulness, and honesty. She dislikes pretending or imagining things as different from reality and disapproves of excessive emotional outbursts like crying or laughing. Though initially strict and opposed to gratifying children's desires, she possesses a hidden sense of justice and guilt, standing up for Nell when others mock her and gradually learning to care for the children under her roof.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P13](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0013), [v1 c6 P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c8 P13](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0013), [v1 c8 P14](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0014), [v1 c8 P15](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0015), [v1 c8 P17](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0017), [v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028), [v2 c22 P18](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0018), [v2 c22 P24](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0024)_

## Goals

- do right by the orphaned children in her care  <sub>[v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007)</sub>

## History

Thirza and her brother Obed decided to adopt a ten or eleven-year-old orphan boy from Nova Scotia. Due to a mix-up in communication involving Nancy and Mrs. Tranter, an orphaned girl named Nell Harcourt was brought to Grey Shutters instead. Although Thirza initially planned to return Nell to the orphanage or hand her over to Mrs. Peter Scobie, she ultimately yielded to Obed's wishes and agreed to keep her. She taught Nell household duties and stood up for the child when Mrs. Agatha Sowerby insulted her appearance. Years later, Thirza also agreed to take in the orphaned twins Robin and Lucy Farrow at Grey Shutters, managing the farm's rental income to support the household and held funds in trust for their care after their father Richard Farrow died.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P27](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0027), [v1 c1 P28](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0028), [v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c3 P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), [v1 c3 P52](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0052), [v1 c6 P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 c6 P7](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0007), [v1 c6 P8](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0008), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P24](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0024), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025)_
